title: McDonald's Japan app database breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: McDonald's Japan
subject.about: McDonald's Japan (Nihon McDonald's) runs the McDonald's hamburger restaurant chain in Japan. Its parent, McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by McDonald's Japan, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: McDonald's runs about 3,000 restaurants across Japan and its app is used to order in them. The company has not said how many app users were affected, so the real reach is not known.
who_is_affected: People in Japan who use the official McDonald's app. The company has not said how many. It says names, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses and card details were not involved, and that users need not change passwords or do anything for now.

known.text: McDonald's Japan says a third party got unauthorized access to part of the customer information in its official app's database.
The information involved was purchase history, an internal customer ID, IP addresses and phone location data.
The access used login credentials, which the company is cancelling.
The company is investigating and reporting the incident to Japan's privacy regulator.

not_known.text: How many app users were affected.
Whether any data was actually copied.
